issue.title: bench_tui_jk fleet fault scenarios (hung_host, reconnect_churn, event_burst) exceed the 16 ms j/k p95 budget on athena
issue.description:
Reproduced in two consecutive runs at master 404b0e2ac2 on athena (load average 18.0, then 4.9), with
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py` (full file, then only these nodes).
Budget is 16 ms p95 (assertion at tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_fleet.py:135). Second (low-load) run:

- `[hung_host]`: next p50 11.6 / p95 31.7 / max 40.9 ms; prev p50 12.8 / p95 32.9 / max 50.5 ms
- `[reconnect_churn]`: next p50 11.8 / p95 25.7 / max 39.7 ms; prev p50 11.9 / p95 27.2 / max 38.9 ms
- `[event_burst]`: next p50 12.3 / p95 17.8 / max 55.2 ms; prev p50 13.7 / p95 18.6 / max 40.4 ms

All three parameters also failed in the sase-1eq.5.1.6 (tui-goldens) run and on its clean base (phase note #2).
The same "three Fleet fault scenarios" misses were recorded on 2026-09-25 in sase-17m.5.1.6.4 and sase-17d.5
notes, yet no task bead names them. The failure holds across load levels and across weeks, so it is a
true budget miss, not a flake. Root cause is unknown: either the fleet-row j/k paint path regressed
past budget or the 16 ms budget was never calibrated for athena. Proposed by phase sase-1eq.5.1.6
note #2 and triaged by the sase-1eq.5.1 land agent. The sase-1eq.5.1 epic adds no navigation work.
